items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: And put Kid Ory get Orrie in there. [Ory]

ctx.x: I see. You've mentioned he and the kid. Or was it Kid Ory or Papa Mutt? Did we talk about the Kid Ory already? I don't think so. But let's go back to Papa Mutt. You said that Montoull and Papa Mutt were together quite a bit.
And put Kid Ory get Orrie in there. [Ory]
The three of them were close all the time, as far as playing together?
